name: Milanote
description_en:
Milanote is a visual workspace for organising creative projects. A board can bring notes, reference images, links, video, sketches and tasks together, then be shared for viewing, comments or editing. It is more useful to evaluate as a project board than as a linear word processor.

Creative planning examples on the official site include moodboards, storyboards, writing research and campaign planning. These are documented use patterns, not evidence of measured creative or commercial outcomes.
description_zh:
Milanote 是组织创意项目的可视化工作区。画板可以汇集笔记、参考图片、链接、视频、草图与任务，再向他人开放查看、评论或编辑。评估时应把它视作项目画板，而非线性文字处理器。

官网列举情绪板、分镜、写作研究与营销活动规划等场景。这些是文档中的使用方式，不代表测量过创意或商业结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine notes, images, videos, sketches and links for project planning.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组合笔记、图片、视频、草图和链接来规划项目。

core_features.explanation_en: Invite others to edit, comment or view boards.
core_features.explanation_zh: 邀请他人编辑、评论或查看画板。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop planning, mobile capture and a web clipper are documented.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档提供桌面规划、移动采集与网页采集器。

en: Collect references and plan a photoshoot.
Review a creative brief with client comments.
zh: 结合客户评论审阅创意简报。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor visual workspace with desktop/mobile apps and web clipper.
Deployment.zh: 厂商可视化工作区，提供桌面／移动应用与网页采集器。

steps.en: Create a board for one brief and gather credited references.
steps.zh: 为一份简报创建画板，采集并注明参考来源。

steps.en: Add tasks and invite a reviewer with the required permission.
steps.zh: 添加任务并按所需权限邀请审阅者。

steps.en: Check free item/upload usage and verify the recipient handover before expansion.
steps.zh: 扩大使用前检查免费内容／上传用量及接收者交接结果。

items.en: Milanote is a sensible shortlist when references, plans and discussion need one visual surface. A document may suffice for text-only briefs; a task manager may be more suitable when dependencies and execution reporting dominate. For a failed upload or missing shared item, retain the source file and inspect recipient access before repeating changes. This research did not verify recovery procedures, self-hosting or an open-source licence, and did not measure app performance or collaboration reliability.
items.zh: 当参考资料、计划与讨论需要同一可视界面时，Milanote 值得列入候选。纯文字简报可能用文档已足够；若依赖关系与执行报表更重要，任务管理器可能更合适。上传失败或共享项目缺失时，建议保留源文件，重复修改前核对接收者权限。未核实恢复流程、自行部署或开源许可，也未测量应用性能和协作可靠性。

pricing.billing_basis: Individual subscription; team bundle needs seat-selector confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free 100 content items and ten file uploads; $9.99/month annually or $12.50 monthly per person. Team seat count/trial duration not confirmed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费 100 个内容项目与十次文件上传；个人年付折算每月 9.99，按月 12.50。团队席位数／试用时长未确认。

sources.title: Milanote - the tool for organizing creative projects
sources.research_notes_en: Creative-project board identity, media types and view/comment/edit invitations.

sources.title: Plans & pricing - Milanote
sources.research_notes_en: Persistent free allowance, individual billing and ambiguous team seat selector.

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Build a brief from collected references
sections.title_zh: 从参考资料构建创作简报
sections.en: For an illustrative photoshoot, collect visual references and source links, group them into a moodboard, add a shot list and ask the client to comment. The site documents combining text and media and inviting others to view, comment or edit. Choose the permission required for each recipient rather than giving every reviewer edit access. Keep source credits with references; arranging images does not grant reuse rights.
sections.zh: 例如规划拍摄时，先采集视觉参考与来源链接，组合成情绪板，添加镜头清单，再请客户评论。官网说明可混合文字和媒体，并邀请他人查看、评论或编辑。应按接收者需要选择权限，不必让每位审阅者都能编辑。参考资料应保留来源署名；排列图片不授予素材使用权。

sections.title_zh: 持续免费的画板内容额度
sections.en: The official plans page gives free use without a time limit: 100 notes/images/links, ten file uploads and unlimited shared boards. Unlimited shared boards does not mean unlimited content. The individual paid offer is $9.99/month billed annually or $12.50 billed monthly, with unlimited content and uploads. The team card displays $49/month annually but its extracted seat selector shows both ten and 50 people, so the exact seat bundle is unresolved. Paid trial duration was not confirmed.
sections.zh: 官方套餐页提供不限时间的免费使用：100 个笔记／图片／链接、十次文件上传及不限共享画板。不限制共享画板数量不等于内容无限。个人付费为年付折算每月 9.99，或按月 12.50，内容和上传不限。团队卡片显示年付折算每月 49，但提取的席位选择器同时出现十人和 50 人，因此具体席位组合尚未确定。未确认付费试用时长。

sections.en: The homepage describes desktop organisation and mobile idea capture, with separate desktop/mobile apps and a web clipper. That supports evaluating an inspiration-collection loop, but does not establish full offline editing or identical behaviour on every device. Try a representative board with its actual media types and a client recipient. Check whether the export or handover format retains the necessary layout, files and comments before promising an archival deliverable.
sections.zh: 首页说明桌面端组织与移动端采集想法，并提供桌面／移动应用及网页采集器。这支持评估灵感采集流程，但不证明所有设备可完整离线编辑或行为完全一致。应使用包含真实媒体类型的代表性画板和客户接收者验证。承诺归档交付前，需确认导出／交接格式能保留所需布局、文件与评论。

sections.title_zh: 适合重视空间上下文的项目
sections.en: Milanote is a sensible shortlist when references, plans and discussion need one visual surface. A document may suffice for text-only briefs; a task manager may be more suitable when dependencies and execution reporting dominate. For a failed upload or missing shared item, retain the source file and inspect recipient access before repeating changes. This research did not verify recovery procedures, self-hosting or an open-source licence, and did not measure app performance or collaboration reliability.
sections.zh: 当参考资料、计划与讨论需要同一可视界面时，Milanote 值得列入候选。纯文字简报可能用文档已足够；若依赖关系与执行报表更重要，任务管理器可能更合适。上传失败或共享项目缺失时，建议保留源文件，重复修改前核对接收者权限。未核实恢复流程、自行部署或开源许可，也未测量应用性能和协作可靠性。

research_gaps.en: Team seat selector, paid trial, complete offline/export/recovery behaviour and regional checkout remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 团队席位选择器、付费试用、完整离线／导出／恢复行为与地区结账尚未核实。
